stem: A hose nozzle falls onto a dirty greenhouse floor just before it will contact a clean propagation area. What is the best response?
choices: Use it because only the outside touched the floor
Handle it according to the sanitation procedure before reuse
Rinse it briefly with nutrient solution
Wipe it on a clean glove
rationale: Hose ends and tools can move pathogen-contaminated material; sanitation prevents recontamination.
